title: Production Platform Realization
objective: Replace reference-only infrastructure with explicitly selected production persistence, search, identity, hosting, synchronization and service adapters while preserving the completed MIB contracts.

scope.purpose: Replace reference-only infrastructure with explicitly selected production persistence, search, identity, hosting, synchronization and service adapters while preserving MIB contracts.
scope.completion_gate: Production adapters pass the MIB compliance suites and owner-domain behavior remains unchanged.

selection_boundaries: MIB-18 and the MIB family are completed_verified before SMB-01 implementation.
SMB-01 is the only authorized product-development work item for this attempt.
Provider and adapter choices must remain replaceable behind completed MIB contracts; owner-domain semantics may not move into provider-specific layers.
Paid/live provider activation, public deployment, tester distribution, commerce and unrelated successor-family scope remain gated unless separately authorized by existing project authority.
Implementation must establish a failing acceptance seam before production code and must pass the existing MIB compliance suites plus exact-head cross-platform validation.
SMB-02 and later work remain unauthorized until SMB-01 is completed_verified and canonical state advances.
next_action: Establish the SMB-01 RED acceptance profile and production-adapter contract tests against the current application main, then implement the minimum provider-neutral production realization that passes MIB compliance without changing owner-domain behavior.
